definitions.short: Mica , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H4316. Mika מִיכָא proper name, masculine (so in Palmyrene, Vog No. 36a ). 1 son of Mephibosheth ( ᵐ5 Μειχα ), 2Sam 9:12 ( = מִיכָה 4 ) 2 Neh 10:2 . 3 Neh 11:7 ( = 1Chr 9:15 ), 9:22 (called מִיכָיָה 12:35 ).
